item.title: ‘Remarkable’: Society credits quick healing of bear burned near Dawson Creek to salve
item.description: NanoTess' NanoSALV has helped Valkyrie the black bear to heal the burns on her face and paws inflicted near Dawson Creek, according to the Northern Lights Wildlife Society.
